variants.name: 環境変数を - の並びで書く・引用符なしのポート

split:
services:
  web:
    image: city-reserve-ui:1.0
    ports:
      - 8080:80
    environment:
      - API_URL=http://localhost:3000
  api:
    image: city-reserve-api:1.0
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/reserve
  db:
    image: city-db:1.0
connect:
services:
  web:
    image: city-reserve-ui:1.0
    ports:
      - 8080:80
    environment:
      - API_URL=http://api:3000
    depends_on:
      - api
  api:
    image: city-reserve-api:1.0
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres@db:5432/reserve
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: city-db:1.0

variants.name: db から書く・depends_on を名前の表で書く

split:
# 予約のサービス（画面・API・DB を、役割ごとのコンテナに分ける）
services:
  db:
    image: "city-db:1.0"
  api:
    image: "city-reserve-api:1.0"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/reserve"
  web:
    image: "city-reserve-ui:1.0"
    environment:
      API_URL: "http://localhost:3000"
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
connect:
# 予約のサービス（画面・API・DB を、役割ごとのコンテナに分ける）
services:
  db:
    image: "city-db:1.0"
  api:
    image: "city-reserve-api:1.0"
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_started
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://postgres@db:5432/reserve"
  web:
    image: "city-reserve-ui:1.0"
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_started
    environment:
      API_URL: "http://api:3000"
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
